notes.title: FINAL DAY for Abomi Nation: Monster Rifts Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
[h1][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/470424787/abomi-nation-monster-rifts-infinite-creature-crossovers"]Help us reach our stretch goal![/url][/h1][p][/p][p]Hey everybody! [i]Abomi Nation: Monster Rifts[/i] has almost wrapped up its [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/470424787/abomi-nation-monster-rifts-infinite-creature-crossovers"]Kickstarter campaign[/url], and we need your help to reach our [b]Nintendo Switch[/b] stretch goal![/p][p][/p][p]We're not even $1.5K CAD out right now. 👀 If you want to pick up an early copy, or want an opportunity to [b]design an Abomi line[/b] that ends up being canon in the final game, please consider [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/470424787/abomi-nation-monster-rifts-infinite-creature-crossovers"]backing the campaign[/url]![/p][p][/p][p]If you haven't seen the new Kickstarter trailer, check it out![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="u_j4IJUEgC0;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]In case you missed it, I've been showing off a different crossover every day for 30 days! Today is Day #30, which means that I can show you the (current) full roster![/p][p][/p][p]That includes new trailers! Check these out:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Ovf8mmJG9Gw;full"][/previewyoutube][previewyoutube="xs6OGV8qFO0;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
Yes, Abomi Nation has welcomed [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1714040/Super_Auto_Pets/"]Super Auto Pets[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2288470/Aethermancer/"]Aethermancer[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1205450/Turnip_Boy_Commits_Tax_Evasion/"]Turnip Boy Commits Tax Evasion[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2113850/Spirit_City_Lofi_Sessions/"]Spirit City: Lofi Sessions[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2075070/KinitoPET/"]KinitoPET[/url], and so many more over the last month!

Check out this awesome collection of indies that graciously crossed over into [i]Monster Rifts![/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181726/229b9e350f40e3b0fde6365d306d6256fe240a0c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181726/5710e0573042982ce85df70600b2c2c9226a043b.png"][/img][/p][p]So many great games are lending so many great monsters to use on your teams! I can't wait for you to get to know them all. If you want more info on any particular game, be sure to browse the [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/470424787/abomi-nation-monster-rifts-infinite-creature-crossovers/posts"]updates on Kickstarter[/url] to get full blog posts on each.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for such a great campaign! Let's finish strong and get this game onto Nintendo Switch, and maybe even hit another stretch goal if we're lucky![/p][p][/p][p]Carl[/p]

notes.title: Abomi Nation: Monster Rifts KICKSTARTER LIVE!
notes.notes:
[h1][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/470424787/abomi-nation-monster-rifts-infinite-creature-crossovers"]Check out all the new reveals on Kickstarter![/url][/h1][p][/p][previewyoutube="u_j4IJUEgC0;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]The [i]Abomi Nation: Monster Rifts[/i] Kickstarter is finally live! Thank you to everyone who's followed, supported, and backed the project already![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181726/ee128cda287433ab07452b31610212df470b4220.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Monster Rifts[/i] aims to take the first game to new heights by introducing a new map system, incorporating tons of new crossovers, and introducing in-game mod tools that will allow players to create their own Abomis and share them with other players via Steam Workshop![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181726/ebf145c17a5aa6536ddba474f0f6b5944f7ef7a4.png"][/img][/p][p]Tons of fantastic indie games have already lent their monsters to Abomi Nation, including [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/674140/Bugsnax/"]Bugsnax[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1942280/Brotato/"]Brotato[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1321440/Cassette_Beasts/"]Cassette Beasts[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1296610/Peglin/"]Peglin[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1082710/Bug_Fables_The_Everlasting_Sapling/"]Bug Fables[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/814370/Monster_Sanctuary/"]Monster Sanctuary[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/725480/Slap_City/"]Slap City[/url], [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1218210/Coromon/"]Coromon[/url], and [b][i]even more[/i][/b] that are about to be revealed throughout [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/470424787/abomi-nation-monster-rifts-infinite-creature-crossovers"]the campaign[/url]!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181726/b34765cb0e7b4a2934598fc7f850d667354bff19.png"][/img][/p][p]
[b][i]Every day,[/i][/b] I'm going to be writing a post showing off a different crossover, meaning that there will be plenty of reveals and surprise drops over the next 30 days. So be sure to stay tuned to the [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/470424787/abomi-nation-monster-rifts-infinite-creature-crossovers"]Kickstarter[/url] to see who makes the cut![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45181726/0d68bee40e179f231bd6345d6da3dbdeac88882b.png"][/img][/p][p]If you want to secure a Steam key, get alpha/beta access, voice an Abomi, or even make your own design an official, canon Abomi, please consider [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/470424787/abomi-nation-monster-rifts-infinite-creature-crossovers"]backing the campaign[/url]! This is all to make sure [i]Monster Rifts[/i] remains self-published and I can continue development on my own.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again to all my crossover partners, and to everyone who's supported [i]Monster Rifts[/i] so far! I'm so excited for all that's still to come in the next 30 days! I hope you'll all go on this ride with me.[/p][p]Carl[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/470424787/abomi-nation-monster-rifts-infinite-creature-crossovers"]Back the Kickstarter![/url]
